children.contentHeading: Getting Started with Mind the Box
children.subtitle: Everything you need to know to begin your journey

children.contentText: Welcome to Mind the Box. We believe that technology should adapt to people, not the other way around. This guide walks you through the platform, explains what makes it different, and helps you find the settings that work best for you.
Whether you're a parent looking for accessible learning tools, a teacher building inclusive lesson plans, or someone who just wants a calmer internet experience — you're in the right place.

children.altDescriptive: A colourful illustration used as a hero image to introduce the content page.

children.contentHeading: What is the Your View Panel?

children.contentText: The Your View panel is the control centre for how the site looks and feels. It's not about accessibility in the medical sense — it's about giving you choices. Think of it like adjusting the seat, mirrors, and steering wheel in a car. The car works without those adjustments, but it works better when it fits you.
Every setting falls into one of three independent axes. You can combine them however you like — they don't interfere with each other.

contentList: Render — controls how much visual fidelity you see. Full mode shows everything. Calm strips animation and gradients. Easy Click makes touch targets huge. Reading Mode turns the page into a clean printable document.

Hover — controls what happens when you move your mouse over things. Full gives you all the hover effects. Gentle tones them down. Off removes them entirely, which is helpful if you use switch access or find hover effects distracting.
Highlight Links — when turned on, every clickable thing on the page gets a visible outline. Useful if you want to scan a page and quickly see what's interactive.

children.contentText: These three settings stack. You could run Full render + No hover + Highlight links, or Calm render + Gentle hover with no link highlights. Any combination works.
Mind the Box ships with over a hundred themes. Each theme changes the colour palette, and some themes come with special properties like reduced chroma (fewer bright colours) or dark backgrounds.
A theme is not an accessibility setting. It's a preference. Like choosing wallpaper for your room — it doesn't change the furniture, just the atmosphere.

Any theme can flip to dark mode. Dark mode swaps the background to a deep colour and adjusts text, shadows, and surfaces to stay readable. It's not a separate theme — it's a luminance axis that applies to whichever theme you've chosen.

High contrast maximises the difference between text and background. Borders become sharper, colours become bolder, and subtle effects like glass blur are replaced with solid fills. Good for bright environments, low-vision users, or anyone who just prefers clarity over subtlety.

Calm mode reduces visual intensity without removing information. Gradients flatten to gentle glass effects. Shadows soften. Animations stop. Badges all normalise to the same quiet style. The content is the same — it just feels quieter.

Every piece of text on the platform goes through one of two atoms: Text for body content, and Heading for titles. This guarantees consistent typography across every page, in every theme, in every render mode.

Parents and teachers often want to print pages as workbooks. Reading Mode turns any page into a clean, single-column layout that prints beautifully. Decorative shapes, gradients, and animations are stripped. Icons with meaning stay. Links are underlined so you can see them on paper.

contentList: Choose 'Save as PDF' for a digital workbook

children.contentText: The platform uses keyboard navigation throughout. Every interactive element is focusable, and the tab order follows the visual layout. If you use switch access or eye gaze, the Easy Click render mode enlarges all targets to at least 64 pixels.
If something doesn't work, or if you have ideas for how we could make the platform better, we'd love to hear from you. The feedback form is always available from the main menu.
Thank you for being part of this. Every person who uses the platform makes it better for the next person who arrives.
